summary: Frontend-only regression of AetherCore redesign audit. Verified experience chooser, deep-link fix on /blog & /precos, mobile responsiveness (390x844), desktop nav & pricing toggle, blog reader modal, and console cleanliness across 17 routes x 2 experiences (34 combos). Everything requested WORKS except one blocker: the FounderMessage component (Bora conversar? card with like button, gallery, lightbox, and inline links to /arquitetura & /referencias) is NOT imported/rendered anywhere in the app.

ui_bugs.issue: FounderMessage.jsx is defined but never imported. The 'Bora conversar?' founder card, like button, image gallery, lightbox (data-testid=founder-lightbox-close), and inline Link to='/arquitetura' & Link to='/referencias' are completely absent from the Home page (and any other page). Grep for 'FounderMessage' in /app/frontend/src returns only its own file. Grep for 'Bora conversar' returns only its own file. The whole feature specified in the review request is unreachable in production.

action_items: Import FounderMessage in Home.jsx (e.g., near the bottom before the closing CTA) and render <FounderMessage /> so the 'Bora conversar?' card, like button, gallery lightbox and inline links to /arquitetura and /referencias are actually reachable.
While there, add data-testid attributes to the founder like-button and gallery-image tiles for future automated verification (only founder-lightbox-close currently has a testid).
critical_code_review_comments: Dead component: /app/frontend/src/components/site/FounderMessage.jsx is 294 lines of code that is never imported. Either mount it on Home or remove it to keep the bundle clean.

SectionRail color is a static rgb(33,29,24) with mix-blend-mode: normal. On the dark pricing-stage (bg rgb(11,10,8)) the label pill background carries the readability. Works today because the label sits inside a lighter chip, but if that chip is ever removed the dark-on-dark contrast would fail — consider mix-blend-mode: difference or a color state switch.

PrecosEditorial mobile scrub amplitude fix works: on 390px viewport all four lines ('Preço é', 'geografia,', 'não', 'assinatura.') render at left:24 with no negative translate — verified with getBoundingClientRect on scroll-in.
GlobalLeakCounter font clamp is effective: number 17.816.217.392 renders at 27.3px inside its dark card without horizontal overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth = 380 < 390 viewport).

Validacao stats grid is visually fine, though one inner measurement reported r.right=310 vs parent.right=290 for the '¥45.000.000+' node — this is a nested inline span with tracking, the visible glyphs still sit inside the card. Not a user-visible clip, but worth a re-check with letter-spacing normalization.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deep-link chooser fix works: opening /blog or /precos directly renders the chooser IN PLACE and the URL stays at /blog or /precos after choosing an experience (verified). Query override ?experience=light|full still bypasses the chooser. Mobile dock (.modern-mobile-menu) sits at y=769-820 on 844-tall viewport; footer back-to-top (data-testid=footer-back-to-top) is at y~624 and PT/EN toggle at y~531 — both clear the dock on /,/precos,/validacao,/sobre,/blog. Zero console errors across all 17 routes tested in both experience=full and experience=light. Blog reader modal contains all specified posts (Quintessence v0.6.0, 878 Testes v0.5.4, v0.5.3, v0.5.2) and closes on Escape and the ✕ button. The ONLY failure is that FounderMessage.jsx is orphaned — not imported in Home.jsx nor anywhere else, so the whole 'Bora conversar?' card + like + lightbox + inline routing links spec item cannot be tested until mounted.
rca of the issue: FounderMessage feature spec item: root cause = missing import + render of <FounderMessage /> in Home.jsx (or wherever the founder card belongs). Reproduction: (1) open /?experience=full, (2) scroll to bottom, (3) observe there is no 'Bora conversar?' section — Home ends with AetherClosing + CtaSection + Footer, no founder card. Mitigation: add `import FounderMessage from '@/components/site/FounderMessage';` and render <FounderMessage /> inside the Home component, ideally inside a <Section id="founder"> so the section-rail can pick it up.
